blind_target.outcome_quote:
Recently, significant linkage has been
reported to a 39.5 cM region on the long arm of chromosome 2 (2q36-37; PARK11) in North American
Parkinson families under an autosomal dominant model of inheritance. We have performed a replication
study to confirm linkage to this region in a European population. Linkage analysis in 153 individuals from
45 European families with a strong family history of PD did not show any significant LOD score in this
region. Therefore, PARK11 does not seem to play a major role for familial PD in the European population.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The European-family replication did not confirm significant PARK11 linkage reported in the Pankratz studies.

luna_triage.reason: The European study explicitly retests the 2q36–37/PARK11 linkage and directly compares its results with Pankratz et al. refs. 17 and 19. The candidate is reference 19, the distinct 2003 Hum Mol Genet enlarged-sample paper. The only supplied shipped row is reference 18, a separate 2003 Am J Hum Genet paper; sharing authors, year, and the same linkage finding does not make it the same original paper under the codebook. The listed prior adjudication file is absent.
